name: EDIFICE ANGELS.
source: An Angelic Tragedy in Three Acts! In this visual novel, immortal angels are bound for life to heavenly megastructures, toiling away in pursuit of God's love and attention. Yet some angels in this undying kingdom seek more beautiful, haunted and sapphic forms of love. How far will they go to change fate?
translation: 三幕天使悲剧！在这部视觉小说中，不朽的天使被束缚在天堂的巨型建筑中，为追求上帝的爱和关注而辛勤劳作。然而，在这个不朽的王国里，有些天使正在寻求更美丽、更阴森、更魔幻的爱情形式。为了改变命运，他们会走多远？
